passages.text: Derek Mellencamp, Chief Revenue Officer Derek is an omni-channel growth leader with more than 25 years of experience scaling brands across direct-to-consumer, retail, wholesale, marketplace, dealer and B2B channels. Most recently, Derek spent 16 years building A. O. Smith's consumer water treatment business. He joined Aquasana in 2010 as Chief Marketing Officer and General Manager, scaling it from a sub-$5 million internet business into the leading e-commerce water filtration brand in the U.S. and helping drive its 2016 acquisition by A. O. Smith. That acqusition kicked off a category rollup with 7 additional businesses acquired and integrated.

He went on to lead sales and marketing for 14 brands — including Aquasana, A. O. Smith, and WaterBoss — across DTC, retail, Amazon, distributor, wholesale and dealer networks, and served on the Board of Directors of the Water Quality Association. Earlier in his career, Derek spent a decade at Dell in sales and marketing leadership roles across the U.S. and Europe, including Executive Director of Strategy in the Office of the CMO and General Manager of Dell's European consumer online business. He began his career in consulting. Derek holds a BS from Vanderbilt University and an MBA from the University of Michigan's Stephen M. Ross School of Business.

The message: This ain’t your ancestor’s workout.
